name: 59801 · Missoula, MT
findings: ZIP 59801 (Missoula) has 205 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59801 (Missoula) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
